prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1107; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Vehicle inspected at the body shop following a sideswipe that occurred while the insured was changing lanes. The damage to the right rear quarter panel, rear bumper cover and adjacent door skin is largely consistent with the reported impact, with scuffing and paint transfer running in the same direction as described. No prior damage to this vehicle is known, and the repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, refinishing the quarter panel and blending the door. The labor hours listed fit the work required for these panels. The shop invoices show no repeated charges for the same operations. Recommend approval of the repair as estimated.
